description: Revenue leaks for one website ranked by money at risk over the last 28 finalized Search Console days: weak snippets and positions against the CTR curve, keyword cannibalisation, checkouts started but not paid, and 404s getting search clicks. Each leak is lost visits x revenue per visit, with its basis (estimate, or upper_bound when it assumes every lost visit would have paid), confidence and one fix. Amounts are minor units of currency (cents for usd, whole yen for jpy).

currency.description: lowercase ISO 4217 code; default the website's main currency

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

name: money_leaks
title: Money leaks
